thesis: CRVL is a high-quality, accelerating compounder in a clean uptrend, with price above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 and strong relative strength. Fiscal Q2 showed revenue +11.5% and net income +22.2% YoY, with a balance sheet that removes dilution risk. It is a non-tech name, so it is not directly exposed to the semis/tech selloff driving the risk-off regime, and the next earnings date is outside the holding window. The setup is only moderate. Reward/risk is about 1.4, the stock is extended near its 52-week high, valuation is rich, and insiders are selling. The right way to own it is a pullback entry in the 86.6-88.4 zone, not a chase, and sized with the risk-off regime in mind.
